name: Default SDD pipeline
description: The default spec-driven process for one feature at a time: specify the stories, design the screens, plan the tasks, build each task, verify the feature and complete it.
body: The pipeline runs for one feature, named by its feature-id argument. Each flow works on that feature's spec folder under spec/specifications/. The human approves the stories, the screens and the plan before the next flow starts; a rejected approval sends the work back to the flow that made it.

flows.name: Specify
flows.description: Drafts the stories and acceptance criteria of the feature.

blocks.name: specify
blocks.description: Drafts stories.md for the feature: user stories and numbered acceptance criteria, each tagged for how it is tested. Asks its questions in the main session before it starts.

flows.name: UX
flows.description: Draws the screens of the feature from its stories.

blocks.name: ux
blocks.description: Draws the screens of the feature as SVG under spec/design/features/, from its stories, with every state the stories name. Reviews them for usability and visual fit before they are offered for approval.

flows.name: Plan
flows.description: Drafts the implementation plan of the feature from its stories and approved screens.

blocks.name: plan
blocks.description: Drafts plan.md for the feature: an ordered list of small tasks, each with its layer, its files and the criteria it covers, and every criterion covered by at least one task.

flows.name: Build
flows.description: Builds each task of the plan: implements it, reviews it, tests it, checks its size and commits it.

blocks.name: implement
blocks.description: Builds the task from plan.md and the approved screens, with its tests, in the files the task lists.

blocks.name: review
blocks.description: Reviews the change of the task against its stories, the plan and the rules, and reports each blocker and warning.
the review reports no blocker or warning

blocks.name: test
blocks.description: Runs the tests and checks the acceptance criteria the task covers.
the check script of the project passes
the change of the task is at most 400 changed lines

blocks.name: commit
blocks.description: Commits the change of the task, with the feature ID at the start of the message.
